interest: This document is an index cross-reference sheet illustrating wartime inter-agency intelligence sharing between J. Edgar Hoover at the Department of Justice and the Department of State concerning intercepted Axis communications. It provides archival insight into how U.S. officials tracked Japanese military intelligence and espionage networks operating in neutral Switzerland (file 894.20254) and linked these findings directly to German intelligence files (file 862.20200/98).
overview: This file consists of a single Department of State cross-reference sheet (894.20254/1) dated July 3, 1942, indexing a letter from J. Edgar Hoover of the Department of Justice. The letter transmitted intercepted radio messages along with their translations. The matter was classified under the subject of Japanese military activities, intelligence gathering, espionage, and propaganda in Switzerland, while the original document was placed in decimal file 862.20200/98 relating to German military and espionage affairs.

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet indexing a letter from J. Edgar Hoover of the Department of Justice transmitting radio messages and translations.
subfiles.summary: This cross-reference sheet records a letter dated July 3, 1942, from J. Edgar Hoover of the Department of Justice transmitting intercepted radio messages and their translations. The document is classified under file 894.20254/1 concerning Japanese military activities, intelligence collection, espionage, and propaganda in Switzerland. The original paper from which the reference is taken is located in State Department file 862.20200/98.
